notes: Combat at 60. Stealth and Garrote on the pull (a bleed ignores the boss's unsundered armor; Ambush gets none of Puncturing Wounds, Lethality or Aggression). Eviscerate at five combo points, Slice and Dice whenever it drops at one or two, Adrenaline Rush on cooldown (Blade Flurry is picked up by autocastOtherCooldowns), Backstab with a dagger and Sinister Strike without one. 2026-11-02 guide rewrite: replaces the 15 s Slice and Dice gate; raid 60 616.75 to 625.5 (+1.4%), bare 60 within 0.1%, bare 20 to 50 down 0.7 to 3.1% (energy-starved, no Relentless Strikes). Every rank named here is checked against this build's own spellconst.

engineering_notes.1: Previously starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit here instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five combo points.

priorityList.notes: Slice and Dice whenever it drops, at one or two combo points. Five points always go to Eviscerate; a short Slice and Dice keeps the attack speed up for far fewer points.
Backstab with a dagger in the main hand: Puncturing Wounds, Aggression and Lethality all land on it, and Puncturing Wounds can give it a second combo point.
Adrenaline Rush on cooldown, with your racial, a trinket and a potion.
Sinister Strike only when Backstab cannot be cast (no dagger in the main hand), held to 60 energy so a dagger rogue never spends Backstab's energy here.

expected_idle.reason: Backstab needs a dagger in the main hand and the ladder wears the highest item-level one-hander in each slot, which is never a dagger at these levels, so Backstab is uncastable on every rung and Sinister Strike builds instead (the second builder line, by design). The BiS band's gear is daggers, where Backstab builds and Sinister Strike is idle.
